questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Bacteria

2. Butterfly

3. Mosquito

4. Vulture

5. Sparrow
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

1. Bacteria - This is the simplest and smallest form of life.

3. Mosquito - A small insect that is more complex than bacteria.

2. Butterfly - A more complex insect with a distinct life cycle.

5. Sparrow - A small bird, more complex than insects.

4. Vulture - A larger bird of prey, more complex and higher in the food chain.

So, the order would be: **1, 3, 2, 5, 4**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

No chart is a casket.

Not a single casket is a house.

Every house is an adapter.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some adapters which are houses are charts as well.

II. No chart is a house.

III. Some adapters are houses

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

No chart is a casket.

Not a single casket is a house.

Every house is an adapter.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcd3273e7fa129e6641129816261fb11faed83badbdd17a6d72880d9adda4371.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some adapters which are houses are charts as well. - False (Because, there is no relation between house and charts)

II. No chart is a house. - False (Because, there is no relation between house and charts)

III. Some adapters are houses. - True (Because, Every house is an adapter. So, some adapters are houses)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**

Here, 'W K J I' followed a pattern.
